photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 14:50:50
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 380 s; on-screen clock 04/13/13 14:50:50, wanted 14:50:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as 'GMT13-102  14:50' on 2013-04-12 (`as run matrix!B96`), read as 2013-04-12 14:50. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-04-12 plus one day, 14:50: it was found 330 s into this video, and in no other video. The fan setting on screen (62) is one the matrix's fan cell gives ('62, 52, 42, 39', `as run matrix!J96`).
